citation.authors: Alexis AF, Johnson LA, Kerrouche N, Callender VD

record.population: Black subjects with moderate acne, pooled from three randomised trials (3,855 people in total)
record.design: Post hoc subgroup analysis of three 12-week double-blind placebo-controlled trials of adapalene-benzoyl peroxide gel
record.finding: More Black participants had treatment success with adapalene-benzoyl peroxide than with vehicle at week 12, with lower lesion counts from week 1. It was well tolerated and no treatment-related dark marks were seen.
record.note: Subgroup of industry-type trials; funding not stated in the abstract.
